svg.title: Payouts per round by tier, testnet demo
svg.desc: Stacked bars, one per 20-minute round over 48 hours: the number of payouts approved automatically (tier 1), by one council vote (tier 2) and by a council majority (tier 3). A dashed line marks the round the newcomer joins.
svg.text: Payouts per round by tier, testnet demo
House community with visitors and a newcomer, launch values, seed 1, 144 rounds of 20 minutes.
